Name: (FF) Ignifex's Playroom and Nursery Furniture
Author: Ignifex
Description:
This is a mod that is heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14612]Kedi's Kids Furniture[/url]. This mod contains 54 pieces of furniture that you can use to decorate your farmhouse! (Or anywhere else, even outside!) I am still in the process of learning pixel art, but I hope you like this! Feedback is always appreciated.

[size=4][b]Notes about this mod:
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Furniture that can be rotated:
[/list][list=1]
[*]High Chair
[*]Shell Chair
[*]Changing Table
[*]Mini Tent
[/list]
[list]
[*]If you want to use the Baby Mobile, I highly recommend downloading the optional file [b][CP] Crib Fix for Playroom and Nursery Furniture[/b] mod and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿ mod to avoid map layering and placing issues! 
[/list]
[list]
[*]There's a config [b][CP] Crib Fix for Playroom and Nursery Furniture[/b] mod: [i][u]Remove Dark Shadow[/u][/i]. Turning this on will remove the crib's shadow that overlaps with the wallpaper's shadow.
[/list]
[list]
[*]You can sit on the High Chair and Shell Chair furniture!﻿
[/list][list]
[*]The texture of the crib on the screenshots is not included in this mod. Unfortunately, I cannot link it here as the author currently has set it to [b]Hidden[/b]. But you can watch out for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Asterisk555/about-me?gameId=1303]their page[/url] if ever they rerelease it!
[/list][list]
[*]There's a CP config to change from [i]Toned-down[/i] or [i]saturated[/i] versions of the furniture.
[/list]
Happy decorating!
